question: How much does replacing PVDF with PVDF latex and CMC raise the solids content of NMC 532 slurries, and by what share does the higher solids content cut the primary drying time of the graphite coating?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p8.L30','p8.L31','p8.L32','p8.L33','p8.L34','p8.L35') OR (page=8 AND (text ILIKE '%51 s%' OR text ILIKE '%45 wt%' OR text ILIKE '%65 wt%'))

WITH a AS (
SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, '(\d+) wt% to (\d+) wt%', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS s0,
       CAST(regexp_extract(text, '(\d+) wt% to (\d+) wt%', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS s1
FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L32'),
b AS (
SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, 'from (\d+) s to (\d+) s', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS t0,
       CAST(regexp_extract(text, 'from (\d+) s to (\d+) s', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS t1
FROM (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L34' UNION ALL SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L35') x
WHERE text ~ 'from'
)
SELECT (s1 - s0) AS solids_gain_points, (s1 - s0)/s0 AS solids_rel_increase, (t0 - t1)/t0 AS drying_cut_share, (t0 - t1) AS drying_cut_s FROM a, b

WITH a AS (

       CAST(regexp_extract(text, '(\d+) wt% to (\d+) wt%', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS s1
FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L32'),
b AS (
SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(l1.text, 'from (\d+)\s*$', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS t0,
       CAST(regexp_extract(l2.text, '^s to (\d+) s', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS t1
FROM lines l1, lines l2 WHERE l1.id='p8.L34' AND l2.id='p8.L35'
)
SELECT (s1 - s0) AS solids_gain_points, (s1 - s0)/s0 AS solids_rel_increase, (t0 - t1)/t0 AS drying_cut_share, (t0 - t1) AS drying_cut_s FROM a, b
